title: Entanglement-enhanced fluctuation-free daemonic ergotropy with random measurements
summary: Optimized daemonic ergotropy can make entanglement thermodynamically dispensable in measurement-assisted work extraction: for a fixed system marginal, quantum-classical states can reproduce the maximal work obtainable by optimizing the auxiliary measurement. We show that this equivalence is broken when the auxiliary measurement is randomized.
